chunks: A woman should not leave herself unadorned, even if only by hanging a necklace on her neck. Nor should she leave her hand without dye, even if only by lightly applying henna, even if she is elderly.

key_terms.الْخِضَابِ: dyeing or coloring, especially as beautification
key_terms.بِالْحِنَّاءِ: with henna, used for light beautification of the hands
key_terms.تُعَطِّلَ: to leave oneself unadorned or neglected
key_terms.لِلْمَرْأَةِ: for the woman; referring to women in general

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about a woman maintaining adornment and using henna?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a woman should not neglect personal adornment and grooming, even in a minimal way. It emphasizes maintaining beautification and self-care, including in old age.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.283 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"A woman should not neglect herself, even if it means wearing a necklace around her neck, Nor should She leave her hands without dyeing, even if it is by lightly applying henna, even if She is elderly."
